d: Mokama vidhayak Anant Singh ki beti Shivangi Singh ki shadi se pahle parivar ko die jane vale lagjari gipht charcha men hain. riports ke mutabik, Anant Singh apne hone vale damad Rishikesh Kumar ko Land Rover Defender aur chhote bete Abhinav Singh ko BMW dene ki taiyari men hain. donon gariyon ki tasviren bhi samne aaee hain. 25 navanbar ko hone vali shadi ke lie bare star par taiyariyan chal rahi hain. janie in khas tohphon se lekar shadi ke bhavy intjam tak ki puri kahani.
